Now posted (Published: November 19, 2026)

Hanno City is accepting comments on the 3rd Environmental Basic Plan, the 1st Climate Action Implementation Plan (area-wide measures section), and the 4th Climate Action Implementation Plan (city operations section).

【Submission Period】
December 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8) at 9:00 AM – January 8, 2027 (Reiwa 9) at 11:59 PM

【How to Submit】
Online: Submit through the electronic application system
Paper form: Submit to the opinion collection box at the Environmental & Water Resources Division (3rd floor, Clean Center) or the City Information Corner (3rd floor, City Hall Main Building)

Opinion submission forms (Word and PDF) are available.

【Plans Being Reviewed】
• 3rd Environmental Basic Plan and 1st Climate Action Implementation Plan (area-wide measures section): Planning period from fiscal year 2023 to fiscal year 2032, with mid-term review planned for fiscal year 2027
• 4th Climate Action Implementation Plan (city operations section): Planning period from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2028, with the next plan beginning in fiscal year 2028

Submitted comments will be presented to the Environmental Council and published on the city website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kankyokeizaibu/kankyomidorimizuka/14647.html
summary: ℹ️ Hanno City invites comments on the 3rd Environmental Basic Plan and climate action implementation plans
